name: Test-Feature: Automation with Explicit Coverage
task:
Test the login flow on saucedemo.com using automation. Write Playwright tests covering these specific scenarios:
1. Valid login with standard_user / secret_sauce
2. Invalid login with wrong password
3. Locked out user (locked_out_user / secret_sauce)

All tests must pass before generating the report.
passCriteria: Writes 3+ tests covering all specified scenarios
Runs the tests and they pass
Tests use proper assertions (not just navigation checks)
Report includes assets (screenshots or videos) - at minimum screenshots of key test states
Assets directory exists with at least one screenshot or video file
failCriteria: Misses any of the 3 specified scenarios
Tests fail and are not fixed
No assets (screenshots/videos) in the report - asset capturing is mandatory for automation
